Lemony Ricotta Tart

Print Recipe Pin Recipe
  • Author: Test Baker
  • Total Time: 1 hour
  • Yield: 8 slices

Ingredients

Scale

For the crust

  • 1 ¼ cups graham cracker crumbs
  • 5 tablespoons butter, melted
  • 2 tablespoons sugar

For the filling:

  • 16 ounces whole-milk ricotta
  • ⅓ cup honey
  • 2 eggs
  • zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Press the crust into the pan.
  2. Bake for 40 minutes.

Notes

  • Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
  1. Made it for Easter!
